objective: Win paid Chinese/English subtitle or QC assignments by presenting inspectable caption and bilingual-lecture proof without overstating linguistic certification or client experience.

source_need.title: Subtitle Translator / QC Linguist
source_need.eligibility: Remote; the page lists ZH among subtitle language pairs and multiple language pairs for QC
source_need.published_process: Send a CV and language pairs to the public resource email address
source_need.policy: The official careers page is a current application route. It does not publish compensation, workload, test terms, or an assignment guarantee; an application is not a lead or revenue.

supported_now: Traditional and Simplified Chinese SRT delivery from one checked timeline
A burned H.264 review preview, source hashes, review frames, and rebuild script
A bilingual lecture specimen with corrected transcript, timed tracks, editable alignment, issue record, and manifest
Public transcription, subtitle-refinement, rendering, and video-delivery tools
not_proven: Compliance with an unseen client or streaming-platform style guide
Native proficiency for every language pair listed by NxSubs
fit.claim_boundary: The public artifacts prove project-owned subtitle workflow and review evidence. They do not prove certified translation, a customer outcome, or acceptance by NxSubs.

application.method: One concise email to the address on the official careers page
application.delivery_evidence: The exact recipient, sender alias, subject, body, and one-page PDF were visibly reviewed; Send was clicked once, and the exact recipient, subject, attachment indicator, and message preview then appeared in the visible Sent mailbox.
application.policy: Verify the recipient, final attachment, and visible sent evidence exactly once. Any test, rate, workload, NDA, assignment, source transfer, contract, or payment must be reviewed on its own terms.
